name: MCB switch (6–32A)
description: Cuts power automatically when a circuit is overloaded.

name: Fuse / fuse carrier
description: Protects a circuit by melting when too much current flows.

name: Modular switch
description: Turns a light or appliance on and off.

name: Socket (6A/16A)
description: Wall point an appliance plugs into.

name: Fan regulator
description: Controls the speed of a ceiling fan.

name: Fan capacitor
description: Helps a ceiling fan start and run at full speed.

name: AC capacitor
description: Starts the AC's compressor and fan motors.

name: LED bulb / tube light
description: A replacement light.

name: Ceiling fan
description: A replacement ceiling fan.

name: Tap spindle
description: The valve inside a tap that opens and shuts the water.

name: Tap washer set
description: Rubber seals that stop a tap from dripping.

name: Bib tap / pillar tap
description: A replacement tap.

name: Health faucet
description: The hand spray next to the toilet.

name: Angle valve
description: Shuts off water to a tap, flush or geyser.

name: Flush valve / fill valve
description: The parts inside a toilet cistern that fill and flush it.

name: Sink waste pipe / coupling
description: Carries water from a sink to the drain.

name: Flexible connection pipe
description: A short pipe connecting a tap, geyser or toilet to the water line.

name: PVC / CPVC fitting
description: A joint piece for water pipes.

name: Geyser heating element
description: Heats the water inside a geyser.

name: Geyser thermostat
description: Switches the geyser's heater off at the set temperature.

name: Washing machine inlet valve
description: Lets water into the washing machine.

name: Washing machine drain pump
description: Pumps water out of the washing machine.

name: Washing machine belt
description: Turns the drum in some washing machines.

name: Fridge door gasket
description: The rubber seal that keeps the fridge door airtight.

name: RO membrane
description: The main filter in an RO water purifier.

name: RO filter set
description: The pre-filters in a water purifier.

name: Chimney filter
description: Traps oil and smoke in a kitchen chimney.

name: Gas stove burner
description: The ring that spreads the flame on a gas stove.

name: Door hinge
description: Lets a door or cupboard swing open.

name: Door lock / handle
description: Locks or opens a door.

name: Drawer channel
description: The rails a drawer slides on.
